Meetion BTM008 Dual Mode Wireless Mouse Black Edition (Dual Wireless Connection Bluetooth & 2.4GHz USB / Silent Mute Buttons / Adjustable Optical DPI Sensor / Compact Ergonomic Body / Power-Saving Auto Sleep / 1-Year Official Agent Warranty)

Maximize productivity and workspace flexibility with the Meetion BTM008 Dual Mode Wireless Mouse in sleek Black Edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt with a 1-Year Official Agent Warranty (ضمان سنة من الوكيل). Crafted for multi-device efficiency and distraction-free operation, the BTM008 features dual-mode wireless connectivity via Bluetooth and 2.4GHz USB receiver, ultra-quiet silent clicking switches, an adjustable DPI optical sensor, and a comfortable ergonomic design engineered for home and office environments.
